name: n4_subscribe_point
description: Subscribe one control point over BOX for a few seconds so its driver polls it, as an open Workbench view would (#875): a point a driver has never read, or that nothing subscribes, stays {stale} with its last cached value, and a read alone (n4_read_slots, BQL) never subscribes it. The tool loads the point (before), sends the BOX component-space sub, re-reads the point every 2 s for at most seconds (default 10, 1 to 40, so the reply comes back inside an MCP client's 60 s request limit), then always sends unsub, also after a failed read: a BOX subscription has no lease, so one left behind would keep the point polled until the session ends. ended is stale_cleared (a read showed no stale flag on a point that had it: the driver read the device), not_stale (the point was never stale), not_polled (the point is down, disabled or in fault: its driver does not poll it, so the subscription cannot clear stale; a note says to ping the device ext with n4_invoke_action), read_failed (with error) or timeout (still stale after seconds, with a note). before and after are {value, status_flags, proxy_ext, proxy_status_flags} (the proxy fields only on a point with a proxy ext); waited_s is the time from the sub to the last read; unsubscribed is true, or false with unsubscribe_error. A component with no out slot is refused before any sub. It writes no slot; the only effect is the driver's normal poll traffic for that point on the field network while it is subscribed.

seconds.description: Most seconds the point stays subscribed
